expectedBehavior: Establish a Mac reference for the active 10.0.402 / 27.0 baseline and capture the actual AOT invocation.
observedBehavior: The supplied Mac uses SDK 10.0.402, workload set 10.0.401.1, iOS manifest 27.0.10722, and Xcode/iPhoneOS 27.0. Restore completed, but the build stopped at provisioning-profile discovery. The binlog evaluates the macOS-hosted AOT compiler pack path but does not prove compiler execution.
limitations: The source capture invoked ambient dotnet and recorded an executable path as dotnet_root.
No global.json governed the source capture.
No executed AOT command, output object, native link, bundle, or signing evidence is available.
Raw report and binlog are ignored local artifacts because they contain host and user-path information.
nextDecision: Re-run the corrected capture script with an explicit dotnet executable, a clean project directory, and a valid development profile or an evidenced unsigned path that reaches AOT.
